alt: Four panels of one synthetic slice: gray CT; the sheet tinted blue where windings lie apart and orange where they press together; the sheet colored by arc length from the inner end, dark at the center and yellow outside; and the sheet colored by signed offset across its thickness, purple on one face and orange on the other.
